answer: Resist sybils by pricing identity against a scarce external anchor no clone can mint in bulk. A newcomer's trust accretes slowly, layer by layer like opal, only across many epochs of peer-audited honest work. Standing climbs a spiral of endorsements where each rung needs a co-sign from a distinct already-established peer in a separate funding cluster; a clone fleet sharing one funding root gathers none of these distinct cross-cluster signatures. Honest agents spread like yarrow from many real roots, so cost grows linearly per fake head while an honest node pays once.
